title: How Lawrence drew him into the band
summary: A group of boys, Josiah and Bush Hall among them, took up instruments, and Lawrence, who managed every band he played in, drew Eddie in. They played a first party for nothing.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Getting my first drums, with or without lessons

blocks.x: Garden King. Why did you, well, due to Lawrence, did he... Lawrence? How did he influence you to try music? How did your... Me and I? Yeah.
I mean, did I... Like in what, the music or...
Eddie, nobody's asking you, how did Lawrence influence you to play music? Didn't Lawrence the one that encouraged you? Yeah, yeah, he encouraged me. How did he do it?

I tell you, there was a bunch of boys around the same age. This little boy was coming up, he was a great connoisseur, they called him Bush Hall. Josiah Frazier was just learning drums. Still on his own show. Right. Still on his own show. What's up, about 16 years old. So they all got interested, so they made me into Lawrence, because he was the manager of the band. Lawrence managed every band he played in. All with Professor Robichaud. Robichaud, he used to play with Robichaud. And, uh, so we got together. Our lady gave a long, a party. Mr. George, had a George mother. And we played that for nothing. Yeah. Yeah, that's all right. That's all right.
